title: Exclusion Monitoring Report
description: OIG, SAM and State Medicaid screening, matches and resolution.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers Exclusion Monitoring. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: OIG, SAM and State Medicaid screening, matches and resolution.

Every employee is screened before hire and every month after.

**Ask:** is screening coverage complete for all lists?
Potential matches by outcome and confirmed exclusions.

Most potential matches are false positives - resolve them fast.

A confirmed match means billing risk for services that person provided.

**Ask:** how quickly was each confirmed match removed?

Pre-hire checks stop excluded people before they start.

**Ask:** any location with gaps?
